name: ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian
type: {ι : Type u} → [Fintype ι] → [DecidableEq ι] → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι → Matrix ι ι ℝ → MeasureTheory.Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)
provides: Multivariate Gaussian measure formed as an affine image of the standard Gaussian; the intended covariance requires a PSD matrix, and a non-PSD matrix yields a Dirac measure.
